channel.title: Dell — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by Dell (dell).

item.title: CVE-2026-103813 · 9.1 CRITICAL
item.description: Dell PowerStore contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. An authenticated user with limited privileges could potentially exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to privilege escalation to root on the appliance.

item.title: CVE-2026-82174 · 4.3 MEDIUM 🌩️
item.description: Dell PowerStore contains a content-injection vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability to display misleading text on the genuine login page for phishing.

item.title: CVE-2026-111545 · 8.8 HIGH
item.description: Dell PowerStore contains a SQL Injection vulnerability. An authenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to disclosure of stored private keys and tampering with trusted certificates.

item.title: CVE-2026-82175 · 3.8 LOW
item.description: Dell PowerStore contains a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability. A high-privileged attacker could exploit this vulnerability to reach internal network services from the appliance.

item.title: CVE-2026-107522 · 7.2 HIGH
item.description: Dell PowerStore contains an Improper Authorization vulnerability. An authenticated user could exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to privilege escalation to administrator.

item.title: CVE-2026-107523 · 8.7 HIGH
item.description: Dell PowerStore contains an integer overflow vulnerability. An adjacent attacker could exploit it to bypass volume bounds checks, potentially leading to data destruction or denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-111547 · 8.1 HIGH 🌩️
item.description: Dell PowerStore contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to denial of service or limited information disclosure.

item.title: CVE-2026-107524 · 8.8 HIGH
item.description: Dell PowerStore contains an integer overflow vulnerability. An authenticated storage host could exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to out-of-bounds data access or denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-82177 · 7.2 HIGH
item.description: Dell PowerStore contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. A high-privileged attacker could exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to arbitrary root command execution on the appliance.

item.title: CVE-2026-116411 · 8.8 HIGH
item.description: Dell PowerStore contains a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability. An authenticated user with limited privileges could potentially exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to information disclosure via requests to internal services.

item.title: CVE-2026-82179 · 4.9 MEDIUM
item.description: Dell PowerStore contains an authorization bypass vulnerability. An authenticated administrator could exploit this vulnerability to bypass multi-approver controls on critical operations.

item.title: CVE-2026-116412 · 5.5 MEDIUM
item.description: Dell PowerStore contains an insecure-file-permissions vulnerability. A local low-privileged attacker could exploit this vulnerability to disclose administrative credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-116413 · 7.1 HIGH
item.description: Dell PowerStore contains a use-of-broken-cryptography vulnerability. A low-privileged attacker could exploit it to impersonate another identity, potentially leading to unauthorized access.

item.title: CVE-2026-86353 · 5 MEDIUM
item.description: Dell PowerStore contains a use of a weak cryptographic algorithm vulnerability that could allow an attacker with existing privileged access to the appliance to recover stored credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-107525 · 5.3 MEDIUM 🌩️
item.description: Dell PowerStore contains an information disclosure vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability to obtain service metadata useful for further attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-107526 · 4.6 MEDIUM
item.description: Dell PowerStore contains an improper input validation vulnerability. An authenticated low-privileged attacker could exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to stored cross-site scripting in the management interface.

item.title: CVE-2026-86355 · 8.3 HIGH

item.title: CVE-2026-86356 · 8.8 HIGH
